Nepal Floods Destroy Homes and Bridges

Severe floods in Nepal have caused widespread destruction, with 35 houses and 10 bridges washed away. The floods, originating from the Budhi Gandaki River in Gorkha, have disrupted transportation and isolated large areas. Emergency services have been alerted, and authorities are preparing to use helicopters for rescue and relief efforts.
